| Method | Description |

| `addNode(Tile tile)` | see addNode(Tile, boolean) with default of True |
| `addNode(Tile tile, boolean twoWay)` | Creates a BasicWebNode and adds it to this custom web path using addNode(AbstractWebNode, boolean) |
| `addNode(AbstractWebNode node)` | Adds a web node to this custom path using addNode(AbstractWebNode, boolean) with a default of True |
| `addNode(AbstractWebNode node, boolean twoWay)` | Adds a web node to the end of this path's list. |
| `addNodes(Tile ... tiles)` | Adds each Tile using addNode(Tile, boolean) with a default of True |
| `addNodes(AbstractWebNode ... nodes)` | Adds each node using addNode(AbstractWebNode, boolean) with a default of True |
| `attachToWeb()` | Attaches this custom web path into the global web |
| `attachToWeb(boolean attachStart, boolean attachEnd)` | Attaches this custom web path into the global web Will automatically call connectStartToClosestNode() and connectEndToClosestNode() based on the parameters passed |
| `connectEndToClosestNode()` | This will connect the end of this path to the nearest BasicWebNode when attachToWeb() or WebFinder.addCustomWebPath(CustomWebPath) is called |
| `connectStartToClosestNode()` | This will connect the start of this path to the nearest BasicWebNode when attachToWeb() or WebFinder.addCustomWebPath(CustomWebPath) is called for this path This will NOT cadd this path to the full global web. |
| `connectToEnd(int nodeIndex)` | This will connect the end of this path to the provided node index when attachToWeb() or WebFinder.addCustomWebPath(CustomWebPath) is called for this path This will NOT connect this path to the full global web |
| `connectToStart(int nodeIndex)` | This will connect the start of this path to the provided node index when attachToWeb() or WebFinder.addCustomWebPath(CustomWebPath) is called for this path This will NOT add this path to the full global web. |

| `calculate(Tile start, Tile end)` | Calculates a path from the start tile to the end tile |
| `removeObstacle(PathObstacle obstacle)` | Removes the obstacle from the available obstacles |
| `removeWebOnlyObstacleTile(Tile tile)` | Removes a tile from the web only obstacle tile list |

### TollWebNode

**Package:** `org.dreambot.api.methods.walking.web.node.impl`  
**Type:** class  
**Hierarchy:** java.lang.Object → org.dreambot.api.methods.walking.web.node.AbstractWebNodeorg.dreambot.api.methods.walking.web.node.impl.TollWebNode → org.dreambot.api.methods.walking.web.node.AbstractWebNode → org.dreambot.api.methods.walking.web.node.impl.TollWebNode → org.dreambot.api.methods.walking.web.node.impl.TollWebNode  

**Methods:**
```java
boolean execute();
boolean forceNext();
String getAction();
AbstractWebNode getDestination();
String getEntityName();
List<RequiredItem> getRequiredItems();
int getToll();
WebNodeType getType();
boolean hasRequirements();
boolean isValid();
void setAction(String action);
void setDestination(AbstractWebNode destination);
void setEntityName(String entityName);
void setToll(int toll);
```

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `execute()` | This is called by the walker to handle the actual walking, entity handling, or whatever else needed to get past this node. |
| `forceNext()` | This is used to see if the walker should AbstractWebNode.execute() this node even if there's a web node further along the GlobalPath that it can reach. |
| `getType()` | Returns the WebNodeType of this node, used during path finding to ensure they're not disabled by the script |
| `hasRequirements()` | This is used to determine during path finding if the current player can use this node |
| `isValid()` | Checks the validity of this web node to see if it should be considered at all during path finding |

**Inherited methods:**
- From `AbstractWebNode`: `addConnections`, `addDualConnections`, `addIncomingConnections`, `addOutgoingConnections`, `clear`, `distance`, `equals`, `getConnections`, `getGridX`, `getGridY`, `getIndex`, `getTile`, `getTileReference`, `getWeight`, `getX`
  ...and 10 more
- From `Locatable`: `canReach`, `canReach`, `getRegionId`, `tileDistance`

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `canWalk(Tile destination)` | Returns whether you are able to walk to the tile, only works with local tiles. |
| `canWalk(Entity destination)` | Checks whether you can walk to a given entity using local walk. |
| `clickTileOnMinimap(Tile tile)` | Clicks a tile on the minimap |
| `getClosestTileOnMap(Tile tile)` | Returns the closest tile on the minimap to offset given tile. |
| `getClosestTileOnScreen(Tile tile)` | Returns the closest tile on the screen to offset given tile. |
| `getDestination()` | Gets destination tile (red mini map flag). |
| `getDestinationDistance()` | Gets the distance from the destination |
| `getRunEnergy()` | Gets the current run energy |
| `getRunThreshold()` | Gets energy level which run will be toggled when using default walk methods. |
| `isIgnoreEntityWalkOnScreen()` | Returns whether the user has ignore entity walking enabled in the client settings |
| `isNoClickWalkEnabled()` | Checks whether the setting for no click walk is enabled or not |
| `isRunEnabled()` | Checks whether running is currently enabled via playerSettings. |
| `setGangplankHandling(boolean active)` | Sets whether the walker should check for gangplanks before walking |
| `setIgnoreEntityWalkOnScreen(boolean ignore)` | Sets the "Ignore Entity Walking" client setting |
| `setMinimapTargetSize(int sizeInPx)` | Sets the size of MiniMapTileDestination 's target area when minimap walking |
| `setObstacleSleeping(boolean shouldSleep)` | Sets whether the walker should sleep after interacting with an obstacle Setting this to false may result in spam clicking obstacles |
| `setRunThreshold(int runThreshold)` | Sets energy level which run will be toggled when using default walk methods. |
| `shouldHandleGangplanks()` | Gets whether the walker should check for gangplanks before walking |
| `shouldObstacleSleep()` | Gets whether the walker should sleep after interacting with an obstacle |
| `shouldWalk()` | Calls shouldWalk(4) See shouldWalk(int) |
| `shouldWalk(int distance)` | Returns whether you should walk - if you're moving, it'll check if your distance to destination is less than specified |
| `toggleRun()` | Turns on/off run. |
| `walk(int x, int y)` | Walks to the tile at (x, y, 0) |
| `walk(int x, int y, int z)` | Walks to the tile at (x, y, z) |
| `walk(Tile tile)` | Walks to the given tile, using a combination of web and local pathfinders, handling obstacles along the way as necessary. |
| `walk(Entity entity)` | Walks to the tile (or the nearest walkable tile) of the entity. |
| `walk(Locatable locatable)` | Walks to the given Locatable , using a combination of web and local pathfinders, handling obstacles along the way as necessary. |
| `walkExact(Tile tile)` | Attempts to walk to the exact tile |
| `walkOnScreen(Tile tile)` | Clicks on a tile on the main game screen |
| `walkOnScreen(Tile tile, boolean ignoreEntity)` | Clicks on a tile on the main game screen |

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `addNode(Tile newNodeTarget)` | Creates and adds a new BasicWebNode at the provided tile and connects it to the nearest web node in our web |
| `addWebNode(AbstractWebNode node)` | This adds a custom web node to our standard web nodes without adding any connections automatically |
| `addWebNodes(AbstractWebNode ... nodes)` | This just calls addWebNode for each web node passed in |
| `calculate(AbstractWebNode start, AbstractWebNode destination, int maxDepth)` | Calculates a web path with a given start node, destination node, and a maximum depth |
| `createAndAddNode(Tile newNodeTarget)` | Creates and adds a new BasicWebNode at the provided tile and connects it to the nearest web node in our web |
| `disableTeleport(Teleport teleport)` | Disables a teleport from being used in the pathfinder |
| `disableWebNodeType(WebNodeType type)` | Disables a type of web nodes from being used in the pathfinder |
| `enableTeleport(Teleport teleport)` | Re-enables a previously disabled teleport to be used in the pathfinder |
| `enableWebNodeType(WebNodeType type)` | Re-enables a previously disabled type of web nodes to be used in the pathfinder |
| `get(int index)` | Returns the web node with the given index |
| `getNearest(Tile target, int threshold)` | Gets the closest BasicWebNode to the given tile within the threshold |
| `getNearest(AbstractWebNode target)` | Gets the closest BasicWebNode to the given AbstractWebNode that's within five tiles of the given node |
| `getNearest(AbstractWebNode target, int threshold)` | Gets the closest BasicWebNode to the given AbstractWebNode within the threshold |
| `getNodesWithin(int distance, Tile tile)` | Returns a list of all AbstractWebNode 's within the given distance on any plane |
| `isLoaded()` | Checks if the base web nodes have been loaded into the client |
| `setPathRandomization(double randomization)` | Sets the randomization factor used when web pathfinding. |
| `setWebNodeVersion(String version)` | This can be used to load web nodes from a prior version, allowing you to ensure any future node updates don't affect your custom web nodes. |
